crossRefs.note: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed…
The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

people.name: Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
translations.bsb: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
translations.kjv: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
translations.asv: Moses commanded us a law, An inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
